name: Claude Auto-Fix CI Implementation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        cache: 'npm'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci
      
    - name: Run linting
      run: npm run lint
      
    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test
      env:
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID }}
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET }}
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_TENANT_ID }}
        DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/testdb
        
    - name: Build project
      run: npm run build
      env:
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID }}
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET }}
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_TENANT_ID }}
        DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/testdb

  security-checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-and-test
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Run security audit
      run: npm audit --audit-level high
      
    - name: Check for vulnerable dependencies
      run: |
        npm install --save-dev npm-check-updates
        npx ncu -u
        npm install
        npm audit

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: security-checks
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Deploy to production
      run: |
        echo "Deploying to production environment"
        # Add your deployment logic here
        echo "Deployment completed successfully"
      env:
        DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID }}
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET }}
        ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARCHESTRA_AGENTS_OUTLOOK_TENANT_ID }}
